Maya Patel: Quick pulse check for the joint conference session with CloudScale + AtlasEdge next Thurs 11am PT. Need: final speaker order, 2-step demo plan, swag drop logistics, rehearsal slots, and who runs the stream. Can we lock speakers now?
Samir Gupta: Locking speakers: Samir (host), Leo (engineer demo), Nina (customer story), Diego (AtlasEdge hardware brief). I suggest demo split: one controlled remote run + one pre-recorded cold-start clip as backup.
Ashley Rivera: Swag plan: sticker kit + postcard + promo code card. No hardware tokens (customs nightmare). Fulfillment timeline: US 4bd, EU 9bd, APAC 12bd. Need final headcount Mon.
Leo Chen: Demo ops: Part A remote on Redwood dedicated infra; Part B pre-recorded cold-start uploaded to S3 and ready to play if latency spikes. I'll provide API key with read-only scope and a small health-check script.
Nina Park: Customer story ready. I'll send slides and a 30s video clip as backup.
Diego Alvarez: AtlasEdge: we'll provide one loaner kit to Redwood for on-site fallback. Units must be returned within 7 days. We'll send serials when ship confirmed.
Maya Patel: Stream ownership: Redwood runs stream; partners as co-hosts. Also add recording consent on registration form and request slides 48h prior.
Samir Gupta: Rehearsal windows: Tue 6pm PT (EU friendly), Wed 8pm PT (APAC), Thu 9am PT (final). I'll DM slots.
Ashley Rivera: Shipping note: mark stickers as "promotional" value $3 for customs. I'll get PatchShip quote and upload packing list.
partners-bot: Reminder: attach ops checklist and set co-hosts CloudScale, AtlasEdge.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Redwood + CloudScale + AtlasEdge: Inference at Scale" Thu 11:00am PT  invites sent to Maya, Samir, Leo, Nina, Diego, Ashley.
Maya Patel: Action items: Samir  speaker DMs + rehearsal invites; Ashley  quote + headcount; Leo  health script + demo bundle; Diego  serials + return note. Reconvene Wed 9am PT for tech dry-run. :thumbsup:
